items.linkedinHook:
I ran the same recurring Monday task two ways this week: once with an autonomous browser agent, and once with a boring 4-step API workflow.

The demo winner and the Friday winner were completely different.

Browser agents shine when a legacy vendor refuses to give you an API. Everywhere else, DOM changes and session timeouts quietly eat your morning.

Full side-by-side cost and reliability numbers in the first comment.

Connecting your calendar, docs, and inbox to AI takes five minutes now. Scoping those permissions so a bad prompt cannot email a client takes ten.

The rule I give every founder and board I advise: read freely, draft automatically, send manually.
